evidence: Changes CScriptWitness storage and transaction/block deserialization bounds in src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/script.h, and src/script/interpreter.cpp.
rationale: Eliminates an adversarial memory exhaustion vector where worst-case valid 4 MB blocks consumed over 100 MiB of memory during deserialization. Benchmarks show deserialization time for a valid block filled with empty witness elements drops from 279.2 ms to 18.7 ms, with peak memory dropping from 182.2 MiB to 7.8 MiB.
